name: vLLM
summary: Apache-2.0 high-throughput LLM inference and serving engine with an OpenAI-compatible API, installable via uv or pip.

Prefer stating PyPI 0.33.0 and that the GitHub latest release tag is v0.33.0rc3. README install: uv pip install vllm, or pip, or build from source. Documented install commands were not executed.
